admin.live.subtitle: Every live run and unit of every department, test runs and Cross-Department Missions included.
admin.live.own_run: You (or one of your characters) are on this run, so another admin has to do this.
admin.live.own_unit: You (or one of your characters) are in this unit, so another admin has to do this.
admin.live.state.accepted: On the way to the start
admin.live.recall_message: They leave {mission} at once with no penalty and no cooldown. The others carry on.
admin.live.end_message: Everyone still on it ({n}) leaves now as Abandoned, with no points, no pay, no penalty and no cooldown. Every mission vehicle, person, blip and item is removed. Anyone who is down is picked up or gets EMS as usual.
admin.live.end_test_message: The test ends at once and cleans up everything it spawned. Tests are never saved or paid.
admin.live.time_message: The timer gets more time now. The fast-finish bonus still uses the original time limit, so extra time never earns a bonus. This run can get {left} more in all.
admin.live.time_not_running: Time can only be added while the mission timer runs.
admin.live.time_max_reached: This run already got all the extra time it may get.
admin.live.empty_text: Runs show up here the moment a type is accepted, and leave when they end.
admin.live.unit_locked: Locked: it accepted a mission type
admin.live.remove_message: They leave the unit at once and are told so. Nothing else changes: no run, no cooldown.
admin.live.disband_message: Every member goes solo at once and is told so. Nothing else changes: no run, no cooldown.
admin.live.units_empty_text: Units show up here when officers team up on the Unit screen.
admin.live.notice.run_ended: An admin ended {mission}. No penalty, no cooldown.
admin.live.notice.test_ended: An admin ended the test of {mission}.
admin.live.notice.time_added: An admin added {minutes} minutes to your mission timer.
admin.live.notice.cooldowns_cleared: An admin cleared your mission cooldowns.
admin.live.notice.extra_runs: An admin allowed you {n} more completed missions today.
admin.live.notice.boss_attempt: An admin gave you another Weekly Boss attempt this week.
admin.live.notice.abandon_reclassified: An admin turned your free abandon into a normal one: the type cooldown starts now.
admin.live.notice.tod_changed: Today's Type of the Day is now {type}.
admin.live.notice.tod_none: There is no Type of the Day today.
admin.runctl.title: Today & cooldowns
admin.runctl.subtitle: Cooldowns, today's limits, the Weekly Boss and free abandons, counted from saved runs.
admin.runctl.on_run_hint: Not while the officer is on a run.
admin.runctl.clears_used_up: Today's cooldown clears for this officer are used up.
admin.runctl.clear_message: {name} can take it again at once. The clear is saved, so a restart keeps it, and it counts towards today's limit.
admin.runctl.extra_message: {name} may complete this many more missions than the daily limit allows, until the daily reset. The hourly limit and each type's own limit stay as they are.
admin.runctl.boss_message: {name} may try the Weekly Boss once more this week. Voiding a bugged boss run also gives its attempt back.
admin.runctl.abandon_title: Treat this as a normal abandon?
admin.runctl.abandon_message: The run of {mission} that ended for a real call becomes a normal abandon: the type and mission cooldowns start now. It paid nothing either way.
admin.runctl.board_offline: The board can only be shown while the officer is online.
admin.runctl.board_operation: A Cross-Department Mission is running: their board shows only that.
admin.today.title: Today
admin.today.subtitle: {day}: Type of the Day, the Weekly Boss and the run modifiers
admin.today.tod_off: Type of the Day is off (Settings → Events).
admin.today.multiplier: Points x{x} on that type today
admin.today.change_message: This changes today only. At the daily reset the normal roll is back. Officers are told.
admin.today.choice_none: No Type of the Day today
admin.today.saved: Today's Type of the Day was changed.
admin.today.modifiers_hint: Switch single modifiers on or off in Settings → Events → modifiers.
unit.admin_removed_you: An admin took you out of your unit.
unit.admin_removed: An admin took {name} out of the unit.
unit.admin_disbanded: An admin split up your unit.

err.live_time_max: That would go over the extra time one run may get.
err.live_minutes_range: Add between 1 and 10 minutes at a time.
err.live_use_end_test: That is a test run: use End test.
err.live_not_test: That is not a test run.
err.live_unit_locked: The unit has accepted a mission type. Wait until its run ends.
err.live_unit_ready_check: The unit is in a ready check. Try again in a moment.
err.live_unit_on_run: A member of the unit is on a run. Wait until it ends.
err.live_own_unit: You (or one of your characters) are in that unit, so another admin has to do this.
err.live_officer_on_run: Not while the officer is on a run.
err.live_clear_limit: This officer's cooldown clears for today are used up.
err.live_limit_off: This tool is switched off (its limit in Settings → AdminControl is 0).
err.live_count_range: That number is outside the allowed range.
err.live_extra_used: This officer already got extra missions today.
err.live_boss_granted: This officer already got another boss attempt this week.
err.live_not_free_abandon: Only a run that ended for a real call in the last 24 hours can be treated as a normal abandon.
err.live_tod_off: Type of the Day is off in Settings → Events.
